relationships.subject: flunixin
relationships.evidence_quote: The results of this study demonstrated that flunixin may be the most effective NSAID in alleviating processing-associated pain in piglets, followed by ketoprofen.

key_findings: Flunixin and ketoprofen restored activity and lowered ISF PGE2 after piglet castration/tail-docking; meloxicam at 0.4 mg/kg was less effective
NSAIDs lowered PGE2 vs untreated processed piglets at 3.69 h post-dose
